devices.line: Izingqondo zakho, izilungiselelo namaphrojekthi kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho. Umsebenzi uhlala lapho uwenzele khona, ngaphandle uma uwuthumela.
devices.lineStore: Imisebenzi yakho, amafayela, izingqondo nezilungiselelo kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho, kuvikelwe ukuze kufundwe yiwo kuphela.
devices.safe: Imisebenzi yakho namafayela akho akhona nakwamanye amadivayisi akho, avikelwe ukuze afundwe yiwo kuphela.
devices.lastSeen: Idivayisi {device} igcine ukubonwa {when}. Uma ungasayisebenzisi, yikhiphe.
devices.store.gone: Le divayisi ayisatholi lokho amanye amadivayisi akho akutholayo.
devices.store.room: Le divayisi iphelelwe yisikhala: akukho okunye okufika kuyo.
devices.own: Idivayisi ngayinye igcina itimu yayo, ifolda evumelanisiwe, izingqondo ezilandiwe nokungena ezinsizeni.
devices.store.unreached: Le divayisi ayikwazi ukufinyelela amanye amadivayisi akho okwamanje: okushintshayo lapha kulinda kuze kukwazeke.
devices.joinText: Kudivayisi enomsizi wakho {name}, vula okuthi {place} bese ukhetha Engeza idivayisi. Akukabi khona? Kukhona ku: {case}. Bese ukhombisa ikhamera yale divayisi ekhodini yayo, noma unamathisele isixhumanisi sayo lapha.
devices.qr: Isixhumanisi njengekhodi ye-QR, sekhamera yenye idivayisi yakho
devices.point: Khombisa ikhamera yenye idivayisi yakho ekhodini, noma uyithumelele isixhumanisi.
devices.pasteThere: Vula lesi sixhumanisi kwenye idivayisi yakho, noma usinamathisele ebhokisini lomsizi {name} lapho.
devices.codeHint: Zibonakala kudivayisi entsha uma isivule isixhumanisi. Imizamo emithathu.
devices.done: Idivayisi {device} yengeziwe. Manje ngayinye ithola lokho enye enakho: izingqondo, izilungiselelo, imisebenzi namaphrojekthi.
devices.coming: Umsizi wakho {name} lapha nomsizi wakho {name} kwenye idivayisi yakho baba munye: ngamunye uthola lokho omunye anakho, izingqondo, izilungiselelo, imisebenzi namaphrojekthi. Bese ubhala izinombolo eziyisithupha lapho.
devices.trustHint: Kuphela uma usanda kukhetha Engeza idivayisi lapho ngokwakho, ngoba okulapha kuya nalapho.
devices.homeTitle: Okokuqala, engeza umsizi {name} kusikrini sakho sasekhaya
devices.homeText: Ku-iPhone noma ku-iPad, umsizi {name} osesikrinini sasekhaya ugcina izinto zakhe zihlukile kwezase-Safari. Thepha u-Share, bese u-Add to Home Screen, bese ukuvula ukusuka lapho.
devices.why.link: Lesi akusona isixhumanisi esivela kwenye idivayisi yakho. Sikopishe futhi lapho.
devices.why.used: Lesi sixhumanisi sesisetshenzisiwe. Kwenye idivayisi yakho, khetha Engeza idivayisi futhi ukuze uthole esisha.
devices.why.gone: Enye idivayisi yakho iyekile ukwengeza le. Qala futhi lapho.
devices.why.key: Impendulo ivele kwenye idivayisi engeyona eyesixhumanisi, ngakho akukho okungeziwe. Qala futhi.
devices.why.relay: Amanye amadivayisi akho awafinyeleleki okwamanje. Hlola uxhumano bese uzama futhi.
devices.why.storage: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukugcina amafayela omsizi {name} lapha, ewindini eliyimfihlo isibonelo.
devices.why.exists: Umsizi wakho {name} ovela kuleyo divayisi usevele ulapha.
devices.why.paired: Le divayisi isivele ivumelanisa namanye amadivayisi akho. Engeza entsha ukusuka lapha esikhundleni salokho.
devices.why.removed: Le divayisi yayikhipha leyo, ngakho ayikwazi ukuyijoyina. Engeza le divayisi ukusuka kwenye yakho.
devices.why.tries: Imizamo emithathu engalungile: ukwengeza kumile, ukuze kuphephe. Qala futhi.
devices.why.declined: Enye idivayisi yakho ithe cha, ngakho akukho okwengeziwe.
devices.why.synced: Lawa madivayisi amabili asevele avumelanisa phakathi kwawo.
devices.why.reverse: Enye idivayisi yakho ayikwazi ukujoyina le. Engeza le divayisi ukusuka lapho esikhundleni salokho.
devices.removeText: Ayisazitholi izilungiselelo zakho, futhi imisebenzi ayikwazi ukuthunyelwa kuyo.
devices.notYet: Idivayisi {device} ayikatshelwa. Le divayisi izoyitshela yodwa ngokushesha uma ikwazi.
devices.erasing: Umsizi {name} uzosulwa kuyo ngokuzayo uma ivuleka.
devices.revoke: Isengase ibe nalaba khiye, ngoba ukhiye awunakubuyiswa. Ukuze uphephe, faka omunye esikhundleni sawo ngamunye lapho wawenza khona:
devices.people: Abantu bakho bathola ukhiye wakho omusha manje. Khipha ku-Abantu noma ubani ongamazi: kungenzeka bengezwe kusuka kudivayisi oyikhiphile.
devices.sites: Isengakwazi ukushintsha la masayithi ku-inthanethi. Ukuze uyimise, vula ngalinye, khetha Shicilela…, bese Yenza ikhodi entsha yokubuyisa:
devices.task.large: Lo msebenzi mkhulu kakhulu ukuthi uthunyelwe kudivayisi {device}.
devices.task.failed: Akukwazekanga ukuwuthumela kudivayisi {device}. Zama futhi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
devices.forgotten: Enye yamadivayisi akho iyikhiphile le. Umsizi {name} uhlala lapha, eyedwa.
